gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani is a modern sans with a high-waisted lowercase that keeps everything tidy and unfussy. But Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, sounds like a storybook voice beside a plainspoken one.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-narnoor: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve. Narnoor, a plain sans with short ascenders above big bowls, handles the text while the display face earns its keep big and brief.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-display: Approachable and tall-bodied, Noto Sans Display fills every word with a big middle zone. And Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, sits above it with open jaws on its curves, so the two share a page easily.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-play: Play is a clean sans-serif with little height difference between cases and a faint weight shift between upstrokes and downstrokes. Mystery Quest, low-contrast, sets the nostalgic mood; Play carries the reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-ramabhadra: Open-jawed and nostalgic, Mystery Quest tucks compact ascenders over a tall lowercase, bookish to the core. Ramabhadra, a clean sans-serif with a prominent x-height, keeps text flowing easily page after page.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-rambla: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look. Rambla, whose small letters stand almost as tall as capitals, reads smoothly and steadily, line after line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-recursive: Compact ascenders sit above tall lowercase in Mystery Quest, giving it a bookish, nostalgic bearing. Mystery Quest sets the mood, while approachable Recursive, with a tall mean line, handles the reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-roboto-condensed: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest keeps compact ascenders above a tall lowercase. But Roboto Condensed, a sans-serif with barely visible gaps inside each word, glides along doing the practical talking.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-saira-semi-condense: Looks magnified, stays level: Saira Semi Condensed holds one unvarying weight from word to word. And Mystery Quest supplies the bookish, nostalgic color while the sans does the quiet reading work.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-secular-one: Secular One reads dense and modern, its midsection swallowing the line's height. What stands out is the gap in era: Mystery Quest feels bookish and nostalgic, while Secular One is unmodulated and modern.
